description: The 50 built micro-widgets. id is what storyboard.json, widgets.json and render-manifest.json use; component is the export in components/widgets/<family>/. Generated from references/widgets-*.md; regenerate after adding a widget.

entries.shows: A cursor glides along an arc to a button on a profile card, presses it, a ripple spreads and the button flips state.
entries.trigger: a person or company acts. "She hit follow", "they signed up", "he pressed buy".

entries.shows: A post with its caption, then up to 3 comments drop in on the spring, each pushing the older ones down; each gets a like.
entries.trigger: public reaction, backlash, "people were confused".

entries.shows: A voice bubble pops in, play is tapped, the waveform fills in `primary` and the timer runs in real time.
entries.trigger: something said in private, a leaked message, "she sent me a voice note".
entries.sfx: `click-soft` on `playAt`; the voice itself if the script has it.

entries.shows: A profile header, then a 3 x 3 grid of posts pops in along the diagonal; one post lifts with a PINNED tag.
entries.trigger: consistency, a body of work, "she posted every day for a year", "this one post changed it".

entries.shows: A phone bezel (the darker of `ink` and `bg`) with full-height reels that snap upward one swipe at a time, with a rail of
entries.trigger: the scroll, short attention, "you swipe past it in a second".

entries.shows: Three columns of 9:16 reel thumbnails pour downward at different speeds, each with a view-count chip.
entries.trigger: overload, endless content, "500 hours are uploaded every minute" (once verified).
entries.sfx: `fast-whoosh` at 0, light `digital-tick` every 8 frames while it pours.

entries.shows: A long-form video card slides up: thumbnail with a title, duration badge, play button. Play is pressed, the scrub bar
entries.trigger: a source, a famous video, "his video got 2 million views".

entries.shows: An ask line with a bouncing arrow, then a keyword types into a comment box, is sent and lands as a posted comment.
entries.trigger: the call to action at the end; never in the first 3 seconds.
entries.sfx: `digital-tick` per character, `click-soft` on send, `soft-chime` when the comment lands.

entries.shows: A prompt types into an assistant bar beside a turning spark, is sent, three dots think, then the answer streams in word
entries.trigger: "I asked an AI", a question people ask, a how-to.
entries.sfx: `digital-tick` on every 2nd character, `click-soft` on send, `notification-ping` when the answer starts.

entries.shows: A home grid of initial icons enters edit mode: icons jiggle with seeded phases, minus badges pop, the target's badge
entries.trigger: quitting, deleting, a detox, "I deleted the app".

entries.shows: A made-up cover lands with a small tilt. The masthead wipes on in the pen colour and the halftone cover picture grows.
entries.trigger: someone's rise to fame, "she made the cover", how the press saw them then.
entries.sfx: `card-flick` at 0, `tactile-pop` per cover line and on the flash at 52.

entries.shows: A front page drops in. The masthead and its double rule draw out from the centre, then the dateline appears and the
entries.trigger: the moment it went public, "the next morning every paper ran it".

entries.shows: The top sheet cracks along a jagged line down the middle. The two halves pull apart on the tear easing and leave the
entries.trigger: what they said against what was true, the cover story falling apart.
entries.compatible: archival-grunge, neo-brutalist-ui (the border is stroked along the tear), minimalist-doodle.

entries.shows: A script page types itself in screenplay layout: scene heading, action, character, parenthetical and dialogue. The
entries.trigger: a quote, a scene from a film, "the line that was never meant to be said".

entries.shows: A file with a title, a meta line, body rules and a signature. A rubber stamp comes down from 2.3x on the stamp spring.
entries.trigger: a verdict, "approved", "classified", "denied", "case closed".
entries.sfx: `sub-bass-hit` at `stampAt + 4`. It is the loudest cue in a film: use it once.

entries.shows: A printed paragraph. The pen marks it up live: a ring, a marker sweep, an underline or a strike. Then an arrow and a
entries.trigger: reading between the lines, "look at the wording", a key word in a document.
entries.sfx: `pen-scratch` per pen mark, `marker-stroke` for a marker, `pen-scratch` for the note.

entries.shows: Words write themselves by hand on a ruled scrap, one line at a time. The key line is in the pen colour and gets a
entries.trigger: a thought, a lesson, the moral at the end.
entries.sfx: `pen-scratch` at each line start and on the swoosh.

entries.shows: A photo print with a halftone picture. A waxy grease pencil (displacement and dropout filter) draws four crop
entries.trigger: choosing what to show, "they cropped the photo", the detail that matters.

entries.shows: Four film strips of 3 frames, with sprocket holes and frame numbers. A loupe glides from frame 1 to frame 5 to the
entries.trigger: the opening hook, "one photo changed everything", the frame nobody noticed.
entries.sfx: `click-soft` at 10, `pen-scratch` at 46, `zoom-swell` at 53 (9 frame pre-roll), `shutter-click` at 62.

entries.shows: A chapter card on paper with registration corners. The kicker rises, the title lines slide up out of a mask, a rule
entries.trigger: a chapter break, a jump in time or place.
entries.sfx: `stop-tick` on each title line, `pen-scratch` on the rule at 34.

entries.shows: One unit cloned into a grid ("3 in 10"). The units stamp in one by one, then the counted ones fill with series 0 and
entries.trigger: a share or a ratio, "1 in 4", "3 of every 10".
entries.sfx: `tactile-pop` per unit at 6 + 2i, `digital-tick` per lit unit from `hitAt`.

entries.shows: A 24-hour dial with 96 ticks and 00/06/12/18 outside the ring. The hand sweeps from `from` to `to` over 48 frames; the
entries.trigger: a schedule, a shift, sleep, "he worked from 4 a.m. to 9 p.m.".

entries.shows: A gauge. The outer tick ring turns slowly anticlockwise and a dashed inner ring clockwise. The gauge arc fills to
entries.trigger: a percentage, a load, a completion rate, "72% of the grid".

entries.shows: An editor pane. The header shows the file name and a live "LN xx COL xx". Code types in at `cps` characters per frame
entries.trigger: "one line of code", a bug, an algorithm, a formula.

entries.shows: A made-up note (guilloche, rosette, "SPECIMEN · NOT LEGAL TENDER") slides in. Its value rolls from `from` to `to` while
entries.trigger: inflation, purchasing power, "what 100 buys now".

entries.shows: A ranked list whose values run through keyframes. Each row is a tabular rank, a label above a pill bar, and a tabular
entries.trigger: a ranking that changes over time, "who overtook whom".

entries.shows: A calendar grid (default 20 x 7) of activity levels 0-4. A playhead sweeps the columns; cells light as it passes and
entries.trigger: a streak, a habit, daily activity, "every day for 20 weeks".

entries.shows: A 10 x 10 grid. The seeded survivors light up; the rest shrink and fall over 30 frames while the count rolls from the
entries.trigger: survival and failure rates, "7 of 100 are still standing".

entries.shows: An edit timeline. A year ruler sits over tracks V2, V1 and A1; clips pop in, then a series 1 playhead scrubs from the
entries.trigger: a life or company story told as an edit, "the arc from garage to crash to rebuild".
entries.compatible: no style lists it yet; it fits any style with a dark `surface`.
entries.sfx: `card-flick` as each clip builds, `click-soft` as the playhead enters a clip.

entries.shows: A shortcut or a typed number as physical keys. Caps pop in, separated by "+", then each one presses down in turn on the
entries.trigger: a shortcut, a command, "one keystroke undid it".
entries.compatible: no style lists it yet; it fits any style with a card.
entries.sfx: `click-soft` per key at `pressAt` + i x `each`, `notification-ping` at the end + 4.

entries.shows: Focus pulls from the subject to the lit tower window over `rackFrames`. A plane's blur is its depth distance from the
entries.trigger: the story moves from one thing to the next.

entries.shows: A 5 percent push builds to `hitAt`. For `impact.frames` (2) frames the shot is a silhouette: sky in the impact sky
entries.trigger: the payoff word, once per film (hormozi-kinetic), a hard landing (voxel-art).

entries.shows: The camera pushes from `d0` to `d1` while the focal length falls with it (f = f0 x d / d0), so the subject keeps its
entries.trigger: dread or a realisation, "and then it clicked".

entries.shows: A blade of light runs along a diagonal cut on the whip easing, then the two halves of shot A slide apart along the
entries.trigger: a hard change of time or place, before and after.
entries.compatible: no style lists it yet; it fits any style with a whip easing.

entries.shows: A print look built up over the shot one layer at a time: gate weave, grain, flicker, vignette, dust, scratch. Each
entries.trigger: archive footage, the past, "always, on the last layer" in archival-grunge.
entries.sfx: `click-soft` per layer, `stop-tick` on the film rate.

entries.shows: A lens pops open, travels to the lit window on an arc and, on the lock spring, magnifies `zoom` times inside the ring.
entries.trigger: one small detail matters.

entries.shows: Before and after on one shot. Left of the divider is the flat log look (a CSS filter on the shot only); right of it is
entries.trigger: before and after, raw against finished.
entries.compatible: no style lists it yet; it fits any style with a card.

entries.shows: A ring cursor samples three points of the shot (the sun, the coat, the tower). The ring fills with each sample, a
entries.trigger: a colour or a value is sampled.
entries.sfx: `click-soft` per sample, `digital-tick` while a hex decodes.

entries.shows: A cursor drags a file (page, folded corner, extension badge) on an arc into a dashed drop zone. The zone lights while
entries.trigger: footage, a file or data goes in, "I fed it 600 MB of tape".
entries.compatible: no style lists it yet; it fits any style with a card.
entries.sfx: `click-soft` at `dragAt`, `tactile-pop` at `dropAt`, `digital-tick` during upload, `notification-ping` at the end.

entries.shows: A line icon (`camera`, `film`, `mic`, `bell`, `play`, `heart`) pops in, then a ring and a slash draw over it in the
entries.trigger: a rule, a thing ruled out, "no stock footage".
entries.compatible: no style lists it yet; it fits any style with a card.

entries.shows: Two to five heads (head only), each with its own hair silhouette (bun, crop, long, curls, side part) and one brow,
entries.trigger: groups, opinions, surveys, "most people think".

entries.shows: The word is a window cut in the card: the next scene (a `knock` fill) shows through its letters. The camera dives into
entries.trigger: a hook that jumps into its subject; a chapter cut.
entries.compatible: hormozi-kinetic, neo-brutalist-ui (flat fills). Not named in any style.md yet.

entries.shows: A picture hangs on a wall with a picture light. The camera pushes through the frame on the move easing until the
entries.trigger: a place needs a picture.

entries.shows: On the explode spring the five planes of the shot (sky, ridge, town, subject, foreground) tilt into an oblique view
entries.trigger: the viewer should see the stack.

entries.shows: The old line is set letter by letter at measured positions. A gust runs left to right over 26 frames. Each letter
entries.trigger: an old belief replaced; "forget X, do Y".
entries.compatible: hormozi-kinetic, minimalist-doodle. Not named in any style.md yet.

entries.shows: The default spoken caption (hormozi-kinetic style.md section 5).
entries.trigger: every spoken line.

entries.shows: The first two seconds.
entries.trigger: the hook.
entries.sfx: `zoom-swell` at 0, `tactile-pop` on each word, `sub-bass-hit` on the power word, `fast-whoosh` at frames - 4.

entries.shows: Each word is a block in the style's card look (fill, radius, border, offset shadow): `knock` blocks, with a `power`
entries.trigger: a claim that builds; a list that stacks.
entries.sfx: `click-soft` on each landing, `tactile-pop` on the last.

entries.shows: One word per beat at hero size, centred.
entries.trigger: the hook and the payoff.
entries.sfx: `tactile-pop` on each word, `sub-bass-hit` on a power word.

entries.shows: Three to six storyboard cards wait in a deck below the card edge and are dealt one every `dealGap` frames.
entries.trigger: a film of 3 to 6 scenes; "here is the plan".
entries.sfx: `card-flick` on each deal, `click-soft` on the last landing.
